nodes.summary: The generator of the block-counting process of the Λ-coalescent on the states `0, …, n` (state `b` means `b` blocks): from `b` blocks the process jumps to `j < b` blocks at rate `(b.choose (b + 1 - j)) λ_{b, b + 1 - j}` (a `(b + 1 - j)`-merger), and the diagonal is `-λ_b`. States `0` and `1` are absorbing (state `0` is never reached from `b ≥ 1`).
nodes.title: Generator of the Λ-coalescent block-counting process

nodes.summary: A finite measure on `[0, 1]` is determined by its merger rates; indeed by the rates `λ_{k,k} = ∫ x ^ (k - 2) Λ(dx)` of complete mergers, which are its moments (Pitman 1999, Theorem 1).
nodes.title: Uniqueness in Pitman's representation

nodes.summary: Pitman's representation theorem, existence half (Pitman 1999, Theorem 1): every consistent family of nonnegative merger rates `r b k`, `2 ≤ k ≤ b`, is the family of merger rates `λ_{b,k}` of some finite measure `Λ` on `[0, 1]`. (Uniqueness of `Λ` is `LambdaCoalescent.eq_of_mergerRate_eq`.)
nodes.title: Pitman's representation theorem, existence half

nodes.summary: The block-counting generator is a rate matrix: its jump rates are nonnegative and each row sums to `0`, since the jump rates out of `b` blocks add up to `λ_b`.
nodes.title: Λ-coalescent block-counting generator is a rate matrix

nodes.summary: Pitman's consistency relation `λ_{b,k} = λ_{b+1,k} + λ_{b+1,k+1}` for `2 ≤ k ≤ b` (Pitman 1999; Berestycki 2009, §3.1): a given `k`-set of `b` blocks merges, with an extra block present, either without it or together with it.
nodes.title: Pitman's consistency relation

nodes.summary: Kingman's coalescent is the Λ-coalescent with `Λ = δ₀`: only binary mergers occur, each pair merging at rate `1` (Pitman 1999; Berestycki 2009, §3.1).
nodes.title: Kingman's coalescent

nodes.summary: A merger rate is at most the total mass of `Λ`.
nodes.title: Merger rates are bounded by the total mass of Λ

nodes.summary: Merger rates are nonnegative.
nodes.title: Nonnegativity of Λ-coalescent merger rates

nodes.summary: The merger rate inside its domain.
nodes.title: Pitman's integral formula for merger rates when $2 \le k \le b$

nodes.summary: Two blocks merge at rate `Λ [0, 1]`; `Λ` is often normalized to a probability measure, so that this pair rate is `1` as in Kingman's coalescent.
nodes.title: Pair merger rate of a Λ-coalescent

nodes.summary: The Bolthausen–Sznitman coalescent (`Λ` = Lebesgue measure on `[0, 1]`) has merger rates given by the Beta integral `λ_{b,k} = (k - 2)! (b - k)! / (b - 1)!` for `2 ≤ k ≤ b` (Bolthausen–Sznitman 1998; Pitman 1999; Berestycki 2009, §3.1).
nodes.title: Merger rates of the Bolthausen–Sznitman coalescent

nodes.summary: Pitman's merger rate `λ_{b,k} = ∫ x ^ (k - 2) (1 - x) ^ (b - k) Λ(dx)`: while there are `b` blocks, the rate at which a given set of `k` of them merges into one block, for `2 ≤ k ≤ b` (Pitman 1999, Theorem 1; Sagitov 1999). Powers are natural-number powers, so `0 ^ 0 = 1`. Outside `2 ≤ k ≤ b` no such merger exists, and the rate is defined to be `0`.
nodes.title: Pitman's merger rate

nodes.summary: The polynomial identity behind the closed form of the total merger rate: `x ^ 2 ∑_{k=2}^b (b.choose k) x ^ (k - 2) (1 - x) ^ (b - k) = 1 - (1 - x) ^ b - b x (1 - x) ^ (b - 1)` for every real `x` and every `b` (binomial theorem).
nodes.title: Binomial identity behind the total merger rate

nodes.summary: For Kingman's coalescent the total merger rate is the number of pairs, `λ_b = b.choose 2`.
nodes.title: Total merger rate of Kingman's coalescent

nodes.summary: The total merger rate in closed form (Berestycki 2009, §3.1): `λ_b = (b.choose 2) Λ {0} + ∫_{(0,1]} (1 - (1 - x) ^ b - b x (1 - x) ^ (b - 1)) / x ^ 2 Λ(dx)`. The atom at `0` (the Kingman part) is split off, so no division by `0` occurs.
nodes.title: The total merger rate in closed form

nodes.summary: The total merger rate `λ_b` is nondecreasing in the number of blocks `b`.
nodes.title: Monotonicity of the total merger rate

nodes.summary: The total merger rate is nonnegative.
nodes.title: Nonnegativity of the total merger rate

nodes.summary: Adding a block raises the total merger rate by `b λ_{b+1,2}`: `λ_{b+1} = λ_b + b λ_{b+1,2}`. The new events are exactly the binary mergers of the new block with one of the `b` old ones (a consequence of the consistency relation).
nodes.title: Recursion for the total merger rate

nodes.summary: For the Bolthausen–Sznitman coalescent the total merger rate is `λ_b = b - 1` (`b ≥ 1`).
nodes.title: Total merger rate of the Bolthausen–Sznitman coalescent

nodes.summary: The total merger rate `λ_b = ∑_{k=2}^b (b.choose k) λ_{b,k}` while there are `b` blocks (Pitman 1999; Berestycki 2009, §3.1).
nodes.title: Total merger rate of a Λ-coalescent
